findings.summary: The Roman account lost the guardian spirit, the accompaniment through life, and the fact that every person had one.

evidence.baseline: It meant a tutelary deity, a guardian spirit allotted to each person at the very moment of birth, who accompanied them through the whole of life and shaped their character and their fortune. Every person had one.
evidence.shipped: In Roman religion, a genius could name a tutelary spirit associated with a person or place.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0082, read as requiring the account be narrowed to near nothing.
findings.diagnosis: Every person had one is the load bearing fact. The volume’s entire claim is that genius is universal rather than exceptional, and the Roman universality is the evidence for the reading. Narrowing the account to could name a tutelary spirit removes the evidence and leaves the claim. The verification marker does the item’s work at a fraction of the cost.

evidence.baseline: The word descends from the same root that gives us genesis and generate and genus: to be born, to beget, to bring forth.
evidence.shipped: The word also belongs to a family concerned with birth and generation.

findings.diagnosis: To bring forth is the phrase the next paragraph turns on, and the bringing-forth spirit depends on it. Belongs to a family concerned with birth and generation cannot support the sentence that follows it, so the following sentence went too.

findings.summary: The definition of what presencing genius means was replaced by a definition of what genius names.

evidence.baseline: to call that natal, tutelary intelligence across the threshold into the present: to help a person come into relation with the bringing-forth spirit that has been theirs since birth, and to do for another what a good genius does, which is to instruct them, gently, in how to proceed. We do not give anyone their genius. We presence it. It was always already there.
evidence.shipped: It names the generative capacity a person already carries and the relational conditions that may help it appear.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0088 possibly read onto instruct them, gently.
findings.diagnosis: We do not give anyone their genius. We presence it. It was always already there is the volume’s title sentence, and it is also the safeguarding claim CTD-0088 wants: the mentor is not the source. Deleting it and adding a separate protected line about mentors says the same thing twice as badly, once in the register of the volume and once in the register of a policy document. Both are kept, because the card protects the second.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Five em dashes. Three introduced a specification and became colons. Two set off an appositive and became commas, which is correct here because the appositives are genuinely dependent.
Shaped their character and their fortune moved to was held to shape, which marks the Roman belief as a belief without deleting it. This is the repair CTD-0082 asks for.
The guardian spirit, the universality, the genius loci, the full etymology, the bringing-forth spirit, and the three sentence close.
The protected mentor line, the verification marker, and the prior pass paragraph on the strangeness of the word, which is substituted prose but carries the anti extraction reading the section needs.
